command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0058/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: One 8-bit mov per 0.29.0 row, eight instructions, 60 bytes: four seven-byte instructions with no REX byte (the low %al-%bl window and the high %ah-%bh window) and four eight-byte instructions with a REX byte (REX = 40 for %spl-%dil and REX = 44 for %r8b-%r15b). Every row is opcode 8a (load) or 88 (store), ModRM mod 00 r/m 100 and the constant SIB byte 25: scale 00, index 100 ("no index") and base 101 ("no base, disp32"). ModRM.reg carries the register: %al is 04, %bl is 1c, %ah is 24, %dh is 34, %spl is 24 under REX = 40, %dil is 3c, %r8b is 04 under REX = 44 and %r15b is 3c. The address is always four bytes, even for 0, and the field is signed: -1 is ff ff ff ff, -32768 is 00 80 ff ff and 2147483647 is ff ff ff 7f. movabsb (A0/A2) is a second legal encoding at nine bytes and is not a row. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 60-byte .text.
